verdict.rationale: Codegen's core interaction model is natural-language prompting: agents implement features, fix bugs and write tests based on user prompts. Users can talk to the agent conversationally in Slack, and the SDK runs agents from plain-English prompts such as "Leave a review on PR #123". missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation quality, and evidence that administrative and configuration tasks (settings, org and repo management) can also be driven by natural language rather than the CLI/UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs, write tests, and improve documentation based on your prompts.
